Flight.description: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

Fairy Magic.description: You know the Druidcraft cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Faerie Fire once per Long Rest. At 5th level, you can also cast Enlarge/Reduce once per Long Rest. You can also cast these using spell slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

Languages (Faerie).description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

Spider Climb.description: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. At character level 3, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings while leaving your hands free.

Trace of Undeath.description: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

Vampiric Bite.description: When you use your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can bite with your fangs for 1d4 + CON Piercing damage. When you deal this damage to a non-Construct, non-Undead creature, you can empower yourself: Drain (regain HP equal to damage) or Strengthen (bonus to next ability check or **attack roll** equal to damage). Usable a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
